title: Mall Afterhours Studies
description: Five independent mall-afterhours details that do not share a building: shuttered storefront, empty food court, dead center-court kiosk, bench-and-planter, and directory board glow.
creative_direction: Each image stands alone with its own mall setting and props. No shared geometry. All share the 90s direct-flash snapshot treatment, grainy consumer character, and explicit absence of shoppers and staff.
